subject: design/local-execution-logs
statement: Codegate invocation logs and pruning use .pyxis/logs/codegate, and contract-gate default report scratch uses .pyxis/logs/contract-gate. Explicit shared report exports and codegate verdict, cache, and worktree state retain their existing artifact or state locations. The removed browser annotation driver and E2E authoring commands no longer have diagnostic-log producers.
intent: Preserve the independent gate logging rules after retiring the browser annotation driver and E2E authoring commands.
rationale: The prior decision included retired review commands alongside independent diagnostic sinks. Superseding it removes obsolete code scopes while preserving the distinction between diagnostics, shared evidence, and durable state.
fit_criterion: Codegate invocation and pruning tests use the log root, contract-gate uses its report scratch, and the retired browser and E2E authoring commands are absent from the source tree.

provenance.note: Updated after removal of the abandoned E2E authoring feature.
